Package org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.federation.router

Class RouterSnapshot

java.lang.Object
org.apache.hadoop.hdfs.server.federation.router.RouterSnapshot
Direct Known Subclasses:
RouterAsyncSnapshot
public class RouterSnapshot extends Object
Module that implements all the RPC calls related to snapshots in ClientProtocol in the RouterRpcServer.
